facts.text: The environment is PegInHoleGymEnv(gym.Env) and its constructor connects a PyBullet GUI client
The observation space is a Dict with one Box field cam_image of shape (100, 100, 1), values 0 to 255, dtype uint8
The camera image is 100 by 100 pixels
The action space is a Box of three elements, each from -0.005 to 0.005
reset has the signature reset(self, seed=None, options=None) and draws the hole position with random.uniform from the module-level random generator
reset draws the hole position x from uniform(0.5, 0.6), y from uniform(0, 0.1) at z = 0.65
The rest poses are [0, -1.57, 1.57, -1.5, -1.57, 0.0] and reset applies them, then steps the simulation 100 times
step increments the step counter, clips the action to the action-space bounds and moves the end effector by the action offset
step advances the PyBullet simulation 10 times after the motion command
The maximum episode length is max_steps = 500
An episode is truncated when the step counter reaches max_steps
The reward is 10 * (-dist_xy - 0.5 * dist_z) plus 100 on insertion
Insertion succeeds when the end effector is within 0.01 of the hole in the XY plane and within 0.1 in Z
Collision is suppressed when the end effector is within 0.02 in XY and 0.15 in Z of the hole; otherwise contact with the table or the hole ends the episode
step returns the five-tuple (observation, reward, done, truncated, info) and info reports insertion_success
The camera projection uses a 60 degree field of view, near 0.01 and far 3.0
close disconnects the PyBullet client
The project is a DRL environment built with PyBullet and Gymnasium that simulates a UR5 peg-in-hole insertion task
The camera captures 100x100 grayscale images as the visual observation
The README's main installation line installs pybullet, gymnasium, stable-baselines3, matplotlib and pandas

determinism.notes: the package fake seeds its own target draw from reset(seed), so a fresh world repeats for one seed and action sequence; upstream reset accepts seed but draws the hole from the module-level random generator (rlenv.py:97-113) and its PyBullet client is not seeded, so seeded replay is a property of the fake only

gaps: kinematic stand-in only: the fake moves the end effector by the action offset and models no rigid-body dynamics, inverse kinematics, joint limits, gravity or contacts, so fidelity_level is F0 even though upstream runs PyBullet (rlenv.py:16-20, 119-132)

contacts with the table and the hole are not modelled: the upstream collision test that terminates an episode (rlenv.py:179-191) is not reproduced, so episodes end only on insertion or the 500-step truncation (rlenv.py:175)

the grayscale camera image is a synthetic field with the hole and the end effector projected to pixels; it is not rendered from a camera link and does not match upstream's 100x100x1 OpenGL image (rlenv.py:193-238)

the fake seeds its own target draw and repeats a trajectory for a seed; upstream ignores the seed and draws from the module-level random generator, and its PyBullet client is not seeded (rlenv.py:97-117)

timestep_ms is 0: the fake applies one action per step without modelling simulated time; upstream calls p.stepSimulation() ten times per step (rlenv.py:92-95, 154) and the clone does not state PyBullet's timestep
no actuator, sensor or noise model: the reward follows the distance formula (rlenv.py:240-251) but the motion that produces the distance is idealized
snapshot and restore are not offered: the environment exposes no get_state or set_state

the upstream environment was not importable where the gate runs (it needs pybullet and the clone's URDF files) and package code never imports the clone, so the fake was not compared with a real upstream run

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
